    late = max(0.0, -slack)
    z = slack / max(k * mean_est, 1e-6)
    z = max(-exp_cap, min(exp_cap, z))
    urgency = math.exp(-z)
    free = max(float(state.free), 1e-6)

    fit_eff = min(1.0, free / max(need, 1e-6))

    need = max(task.resource_need, 1e-6)

    tier = m if task.tenant == 'premium' else 1.0

    mean = max(state.mean_est, p, 1e-6)
    p_eff = max(p, floor * mean, 1e-6)
    slack = task.due - state.now - p
    pos_slack = max(0.0, slack)
